versions.subject: Windows redcannary
versions.detection:
selection_reg:
    Image|endswith: \reg.exe
    CommandLine|contains: save
selection_key:
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - HKLM\sam
        - HKLM\system
        - HKLM\security
condition: all of selection_*
